title: Finding Artifact Schema
description: Schema for finding artifacts in the foxBMS 2 lifecycle corpus

disposition.description: Disposition of the finding. The six members are six distinct states and are not interchangeable. Definitions are normative and live in docs/artifacts/governance/finding-disposition-vocabulary.md; the short form: 'resolved' = the asserted condition no longer holds and the record says so, with the fix named; 'accepted' = the finding is upheld as a real defect that is acknowledged and NOT fixed, with the work identified and left to an owner; 'rejected' = the finding is not upheld, with the reason; 'deferred' = upheld and deliberately not addressed now, with the trigger that would bring it back; 'partial' = some of the condition is closed and the remainder is stated item by item; 'in_progress' = remediation is under way and named. 'resolved' was added because 'accepted' was doing at least three different jobs across the corpus - closed, acknowledged-but-unfixed, and known-limitation - which left a reader unable to tell a closed finding from an open one by machine.
